_about: How ApplyPilot runs for this user. The agent maintains this file; the user changes it by talking to the agent.
_updates: 'ask': check for new ApplyPilot instructions only while the user is present, and install them only after the user says yes. 'off': never check. Unattended daily runs never update.
_run_time: 24-hour HH:MM in the user's own timezone (the 'timezone' field). The Codex scheduled task uses this same local time.
_auto_submit: true: the daily run sends Easy Apply applications on its own, but only when every answer on the form comes from a confirmed fact or answer. Anything else waits for the user. false: every application waits for an apply session.

skip_if: Not an internship (full-time, contract, or part-time roles that are not internships).
Clearly senior: Senior, Staff, Principal, Lead, Director, Head, or VP roles. Intern titles that contain 'Manager' or 'Engineer' are fine.
Requires a graduation date, degree level, or enrollment status the user does not have.
Says it cannot sponsor, requires citizenship, or requires a security clearance, when the user's work authorization facts rule them out.
Location is outside the user's locations and the job is not remote, unless the user is open to relocating.
Commission-only, unpaid when the user wants paid roles, or looks like a scam or a staffing-agency repost.
Already applied, closed, or a duplicate or repost of a job already in the tracker.
ask_me_if: Sponsorship or work authorization wording is unclear for this user.
The job needs relocation and the user's relocation answer is unknown.
A cover letter, portfolio, writing sample, or video is required.
